method: Replay the original Vulkan shaders, textures, authored emitters, original FX delay and 1/60 sampling clock. Double native pixels per world unit with original root-pivot positions and no rescaling of prior PNG outputs. Transparent RGB is preserved in the sqrt-linear encoded atlas. S3 trail camera moves with the actual original 10 native units/s root path.
rights: Original Hypergryph media. Public redistribution rights unconfirmed.

limitations: Original native ParticleSystem, enabled Animator/Legacy Animation, mesh, texture and Shader; source UVTween and FxDelay replayed by processing harness.

Full Torappu game scripts are absent. FollowMountPoint/FollowDirection are supplied by explicit root trajectories; source lifecycle is only partial. Stop uses native StopEmitting, not original _inactiveOnFinish/Animator finish transitions.
No LOD reduction, intensity change, emission-count change, substitute Shader or stylistic paint. Camera, seed, root trajectories and job timing are processing inputs.

detonationLayerSplit.lettering: Both enabled source renderers at static_offset/fixed/name (1) and name (2), isolated without replacing materials, geometry or textures. The source _MainTex atlas spw_sk_02 contains the WIS artwork and the alternate pale flare. The camera-facing extraction selects the WIS cell via _MainTex X offset 0.5 after replay of the authored per-channel UV rotation, keeping the same original material, geometry and textures. At the original bake camera angle the letter projects nearly edge-on.
detonationLayerSplit.ground: All existing source renderers except the two dedicated name renderers. Same native board-facing camera and detonation source age.
